user.title: KNMI weather warnings
user.description:
Choose the location to monitor. Warnings are checked against the exact KNMI warning areas.

You need a free personal API key for the KNMI **Open Data API**: create an account on the [KNMI Developer Portal]({key_url}) and request an Open Data API key (an EDR or WMS key does not work).

reauth_confirm.title: KNMI API key rejected
reauth_confirm.description: KNMI rejected the API key or no key is configured. Enter a valid key for the KNMI **Open Data API** ([KNMI Developer Portal]({key_url})).

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the KNMI Data Platform: {error_detail}
error.invalid_auth: KNMI rejected the API key ({error_detail}). Make sure it is a key for the Open Data API.
error.outside_netherlands: This location is outside the KNMI warning area (the Netherlands).
